body.def: Rate-gap handle \(H\): combine the hybrid \(\widehat U^{\mathrm H}\) and its \(1\wedge a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) bound in loss \(\mathcal L\) with the \(b_{nm}\) packing, then search over \(\mathfrak E_{n,m}\) under the row-major filtration \(\mathbb G\) before evaluating \(C_\star\).
body.role: Rate-gap handle preceding any sharp-constant calculation.
